mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 64 degrees out by Badger Prairie County Park. If you are looking up at the sky tonight, the International Space Station will be visible for one minute starting at 7:40 PM, rising in the west southwest over Mount Horeb and passing high in the sky toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot.

Regarding city news, authorities reported an incident on September 10th on Hunter's Cove Way. Officers arrived to find a burglary in progress where a suspect was taken into custody and a handgun was recovered after a shell casing was found at the scene. No injuries resulted from the firearm discharge.

There is a lot happening this weekend. Today, we have the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival, along with live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga, and keep an eye out for trivia and market events beginning this coming Monday and Tuesday.

A notable incident occurred on September 10th when Verona police were dispatched to a residence on Hunter's Cove Way following a report of a burglary and a single gunshot, leading to the arrest of a Madison man.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. Culver's is currently open and serving guests until their 10:00 PM closing time tonight, so feel free to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
